ruleset.name: nitpicker
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD categories for main and test sources.

rule.message: Field {0} has the same name as a method. Rename one of them; a method named exactly like its field with at most one parameter (an accessor, a fluent setter or builder step) is allowed.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static' and pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final')]/VariableDeclarator/VariableId [some $method in ../../..[self::ClassBody or self::EnumBody]/MethodDeclaration satisfies lower-case(@Name) = lower-case($method/@Name) and not(@Name = $method/@Name and $method/FormalParameters[@Size < 2])]

rule.message: Use a named constant instead of this literal in the condition (-1, 0, 1 and 2 are allowed).
Assign first, then use the variable. An assignment in a while condition is allowed.
Pass values as placeholders (LOG.debug("user '{'}", user)) and compute nothing in the arguments; guard the call with isDebugEnabled() only when an argument must be computed.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: ./MethodCall[ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral]] [not(ArgumentList/*[position() > 1][not( self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression or self::StringLiteral or self::NumericLiteral or self::BooleanLiteral or self::CharLiteral or self::NullLiteral or (self::MethodCall[ArgumentList[@Size = 0]] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression]]))])]

rule.name: LogStringConcatenation
rule.message: Pass values as placeholders (LOG.info("user '{'}", user); '{'0} in System.Logger and java.util.logging), not a message built with + or String.format.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('info', 'warn', 'error', 'log', 'config', 'warning', 'severe')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.logging.Log')]] /ArgumentList/(*[1] | *[1][not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String'))]/following-sibling::*[1]) [(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'] and not(@CompileTimeConstant = true())) or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('format', 'formatted')]]

rule.name: GeneratedOnHandWrittenCode
rule.message: JaCoCo and PIT skip code annotated @Generated, so this is not measured. Remove the annotation from hand-written code.

rule.name: TaskOutlivesTryResource
rule.message: This task uses a try-with-resources resource but nothing waits for it before the block ends, so the resource is closed while the task can still run. Wait for it inside the block (get() or join() on the future, or awaitTermination on the executor), declare the executor as a later resource of the same try so it closes first and waits, or open the resource inside the task.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall [@MethodName = ('submit', 'execute', 'schedule', 'scheduleAtFixedRate', 'scheduleWithFixedDelay') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Executor') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionService') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Timer')] or @MethodName = ('supplyAsync', 'runAsync') and *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture')] or @MethodName = ('thenApplyAsync', 'thenAcceptAsync', 'thenRunAsync', 'thenComposeAsync', 'whenCompleteAsync', 'handleAsync') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage')] or @MethodName = 'startVirtualThread' and *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')] or @MethodName = 'start' and *[1][self::ConstructorCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')] or @MethodName = 'start' and *[1][self::MethodCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread.Builder')]] [let $s := . return some $block in ancestor::Block[parent::TryStatement[ResourceList]] satisfies (let $receiver := *[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name, $arguments := (ArgumentList/*, *[1][self::ConstructorCall]/ArgumentList/*), $resources := $block/parent::TryStatement/ResourceList/Resource, $captured := $resources[ let $name := (LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, VariableAccess/@Name) return exists($arguments[self::LambdaExpression or self::MethodReference or self::ConstructorCall[AnonymousClassDeclaration]] //VariableAccess[@Name = $name]) or exists($arguments[self::ConstructorCall]/ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $name])], $chain := $s/ancestor-or-self::MethodCall[ every $step in ($s/ancestor::* intersect ./descendant::*) satisfies $step/self::MethodCall], $top := $chain[1], $holder := ($top/parent::VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, $top/parent::AssignmentExpression[*[2] is $top]/*[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name), $uses := $block//VariableAccess[@Name = $holder][not(parent::AssignmentExpression and . is ../*[1])] return exists($captured) and not(ancestor::*[self::LambdaExpression or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration][. >> $block]) and not($chain[@MethodName = ('get', 'join', 'getNow', 'resultNow', 'awaitTermination')]) and ($top/parent::ExpressionStatement or $top/parent::ReturnStatement or (exists($holder) and (every $use in $uses satisfies $use/parent::ReturnStatement))) and (some $resource in $captured satisfies empty($resource/following-sibling::Resource[ (LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, VariableAccess/@Name) = $receiver])) and empty($block//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('awaitTermination', 'close')] [*[1][self::VariableAccess/@Name = $receiver]]))]
